R01.title: Product name declared
R01.description: The label must clearly declare the common/generic name of the commodity.

R02.title: Commodity category declared
R02.description: The commodity category/type should be identifiable for classification purposes.

R03.title: Manufacturer name declared
R03.description: Name of the manufacturer/packer/marketer must be declared on the label.

R04.title: Manufacturer address declared
R04.description: Complete address of the manufacturer/packer/marketer must be declared.

R05.title: Batch/Lot number present and valid
R05.description: A batch or lot number is required for traceability and recalls.

R06.title: Net quantity declared with valid unit
R06.description: Net quantity must be declared in standard metric units (g/kg/ml/l/pcs).

R07.title: Manufacturing date present and valid
R07.description: Date of manufacture/packing should be declared in a recognizable date format.

R08.title: Expiry date or best-before period present
R08.description: At least one of expiry date / best-before must be declared for consumer safety.

R09.title: Manufacturing date precedes expiry date
R09.description: When both dates are present, manufacturing date must be before the expiry date.

R10.title: Product is not already expired
R10.description: The declared expiry date must not be earlier than the scan date.

R11.title: Ingredients list declared
R11.description: A list of ingredients should be declared, most food/cosmetic commodities require this.

R12.title: License/registration number present and valid
R12.description: A regulatory license or registration number (e.g. FSSAI) must be present and numeric.

R13.title: Country of origin declared
R13.description: Country of origin must be declared per Legal Metrology labelling rules.
R13.mandate: Rule 6(10) Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules

R14.title: Batch number meets minimum traceability length
R14.description: Batch/lot codes shorter than 4 characters offer weak traceability.

R15.title: Ingredients list is not obviously truncated
R15.description: A very short ingredients string usually indicates an incomplete OCR read or label.
